transcript: I don't care if I get thrown a baseball, a football, a basketball, I'm going to play the game and I'm going to play it really really really well. I do not want to win second place. I like first place. It's always me against past versions of myself. I enjoy the thrill of being able to play and play against myself. That is confirmation for me that I'm learning, I'm exploring, I'm growing, I'm getting stronger, I'm getting smarter. I am gaining more wisdom. I will always play against myself and play to win.
